project.name: Finance Live Portfolio Management API
project.description: Live portfolio management layer alongside the existing backtest engine. Adds LivePortfolio input type, rebalance planning, LEAPS greeks, volatility reporting, GTT status, and a LEAPS DCA entry signal.
project.overview: Two distinct flows: the existing run_backtest() path and a new live management path. Live management accepts a user-constructed LivePortfolio (brokerage state) and produces RebalancePlan, PortfolioGreeks, VolatilityReport, and GttStatus. A bridge function (as_live_portfolio) converts BacktestResult.final_state into a LivePortfolio. A new dca_signal module computes a multi-factor LEAPS DCA entry score. Phase 0 refactors are a strict prerequisite.

data_schemas.name: LivePortfolio
data_schemas.description: User's current brokerage portfolio state as of a specific date. Self-contained and user-constructible without understanding backtest internals.

fields.name: holdings
fields.description: Base asset ticker → current dollar value.

fields.name: target_weights
fields.description: Target allocation. Must sum to 1.0 within 1e-6.

fields.name: leaps_contracts
fields.description: Active LEAPS contracts with surviving fraction (scale ∈ (0, 1]). Empty tuple if no LEAPS.

fields.name: defensive_sleeve
fields.description: Dollar value in GTT defensive allocation. Default 0.0.

fields.name: leaps_pool
fields.description: Force-closed LEAPS proceeds parked during defensive window. Default 0.0.

fields.name: leaps_nav
fields.description: Mark-to-market value of all active LEAPS contracts (caller-supplied).

data_schemas.name: HoldingView
data_schemas.description: Single asset row in a portfolio weight drift analysis.

data_schemas.name: TradeOrder
data_schemas.description: Single buy/sell instruction from a rebalance simulation.

fields.name: trade_amount
fields.description: target_value - current_value. Positive = buy, negative = sell.

data_schemas.name: RebalancePlan
data_schemas.description: Simulated rebalance outcome for a LivePortfolio. Pure: does not mutate portfolio.

fields.name: would_trigger
fields.description: Whether the rebalance rule fires at this date.

fields.name: trades
fields.description: Per-asset buy/sell instructions. Empty tuple if not triggered.

fields.name: leaps_trim
fields.description: Dollar reduction to LEAPS (positive = LEAPS partially closed). Non-zero only when DRIFT rule fires and LEAPS overweight.

fields.name: contribution_table
fields.description: DataFrame from build_vol_contribution_table(). Columns: sigma_tilde, sigma_hat, rho_VTI, contrib.

fields.name: weights_used
fields.description: Realized weights used in contribution computation.

fields.name: ue_signal
fields.description: UE_12M signal value at as_of_date (0 or 1).

fields.name: vix_signal
fields.description: VIX_5D signal value at as_of_date (0 or 1).

fields.name: vix_current
fields.description: Raw VIX value at as_of_date (decimal, e.g. 0.21).

data_schemas.name: ContractGreeks
data_schemas.description: Black-Scholes greeks for a single LeapsContract. All position-level fields scaled by (n_contracts * CONTRACT_MULTIPLIER * leaps_scale).

fields.name: gamma
fields.description: d²V/dS². Always positive for long calls.

fields.name: theta
fields.description: dV/dt in dollars per calendar day (negative for long calls).

fields.name: charm
fields.description: dDelta/dt. Delta decay per calendar day.

data_schemas.name: PortfolioGreeks
data_schemas.description: Aggregate greeks across all active LEAPS contracts in a LivePortfolio.

fields.name: net_theta
fields.description: Total dollar theta per calendar day.

data_schemas.name: LeapsDcaSignal
data_schemas.description: Multi-factor composite entry score for DITM LEAPS DCA timing.

fields.name: entry_score
fields.description: Composite score in [0, 100]. Higher = more favorable entry.

fields.name: score_percentile
fields.description: entry_score rank within the lookback window (0–100).

fields.name: macd_bearish_confirmed
fields.description: True if MACD histogram negative for ≥ 3 consecutive sessions.

data_schemas.name: BacktestResult (modified)
data_schemas.description: Existing BacktestResult extended with final_state field to enable as_live_portfolio() bridge.

fields.name: final_state
fields.description: NEW: loop-end state from run_backtest, enables as_live_portfolio() bridge.

data_schemas.name: PriceData (modified)
data_schemas.description: Existing PriceData extended with optional ohlcv field for Stochastic %D computation in DCA signal.

fields.name: ohlcv
fields.description: NEW: DatetimeIndex × MultiIndex(ticker, field). Empty DataFrame when fetch_ohlcv=False (default).

api_contracts.name: get_live_contracts
api_contracts.description: Relocated from _backtest_steps._live_contracts to leverage.py. Returns active LeapsContracts from a ledger as of a given date.

api_contracts.name: should_rebalance
api_contracts.description: Relocated from _backtest_steps._should_rebalance to rebalance.py. Determines if a rebalance should trigger given current weights, target weights, rule, and band.

api_contracts.name: bs_call_gamma
api_contracts.description: Black-Scholes gamma for a call: N'(d1) * e^(-q*T) / (S * sigma * sqrt(T)).

outputs.description: Gamma. Always positive for long calls.

api_contracts.name: bs_call_vega
api_contracts.description: Black-Scholes vega for a call: S * e^(-q*T) * N'(d1) * sqrt(T) per unit of vol.

api_contracts.name: bs_call_theta
api_contracts.description: Black-Scholes theta for a call: annualized form divided by 365 for per-calendar-day value.

outputs.description: Theta in dollars per calendar day (negative for long calls).

api_contracts.name: bs_call_charm
api_contracts.description: Black-Scholes charm (delta decay per day): -e^(-q*T) * N'(d1) * [2*(r-q)*T - d2*sigma*sqrt(T)] / (2*T*sigma*sqrt(T)).

api_contracts.name: compute_contract_greeks
api_contracts.description: Compute all BS greeks for one LeapsContract at caller-supplied market conditions.

api_contracts.name: compute_portfolio_greeks
api_contracts.description: Compute greeks for all active contracts in a LivePortfolio. Returns all-zero PortfolioGreeks when portfolio.leaps_contracts is empty.

api_contracts.name: as_live_portfolio
api_contracts.description: Bridge from a completed BacktestResult to a LivePortfolio. Uses get_live_contracts() to filter active contracts and pulls leaps_scale from final_state.

api_contracts.name: compute_nav_breakdown
api_contracts.description: Decompose LivePortfolio NAV into components. leaps_mtm is caller-supplied current LEAPS mark-to-market.

api_contracts.name: compute_holdings_view
api_contracts.description: Compute per-asset weight drift against target_weights.

api_contracts.name: compute_rebalance_plan
api_contracts.description: Simulate rebalance trades without executing them. Pure. Uses should_rebalance() from rebalance.py. Assumes Long regime.

api_contracts.name: compute_volatility_report
api_contracts.description: Run the full vol stack on current portfolio weights. Calls build_volatility_model() and build_vol_contribution_table(). Weights derived from realized holdings.
raises: ValueError: if return_data does not cover portfolio.as_of_date

api_contracts.name: compute_gtt_status
api_contracts.description: Fetch current GTT signal and return structured status. Delegates to fetch_gtt_signal_data (two network calls: FRED + yfinance). Not pure — I/O boundary.

api_contracts.name: compute_leaps_dca_signal
api_contracts.description: Compute the multi-factor DITM LEAPS DCA entry signal for a single ticker. Slices price_data to [:as_of_date] before all computations (T1 invariant).

inputs.name: price_data
inputs.description: Must be built with fetch_vol_indices=True and fetch_ohlcv=True.

raises: ValueError: if ticker not in price_data.prices
ValueError: if price_data.ohlcv is empty (fetch_ohlcv not requested)
ValueError: if price_data.vol_prices has no column for ticker's IV proxy
ValueError: if w_rsi + w_stoch + w_iv + w_macd does not sum to 1.0 within 1e-6
ValueError: if fewer than min_lookback trading days available up to as_of_date

api_contracts.name: build_price_data (modified)
api_contracts.description: Existing build_price_data extended with fetch_ohlcv parameter. When True, retains full OHLCV response from yf.download instead of discarding everything except Close.

outputs.description: ohlcv field populated when fetch_ohlcv=True, else empty DataFrame.

risks.description: compute_rebalance_plan called with Defensive portfolio: function assumes Long regime; documented limitation. Returns plan assuming Long; caller must inspect portfolio.gtt_regime.

risks.description: LEAPS near expiry: theta and charm diverge as time_to_expiry → 0. Division by zero risk.
risks.mitigation: TIME_FLOOR applied in all BS functions. Document the floor in leverage.py. Edge case tested explicitly.

risks.description: as_live_portfolio when backtest had no LEAPS: final_state.leaps_ledger is None.

risks.description: compute_leaps_dca_signal called for a ticker with no ASSET_VOL_INDEX mapping (e.g. IWM).

risks.description: PriceData.ohlcv MultiIndex column structure differs across yfinance versions.
risks.mitigation: Pin yfinance version. Add parsing guard in build_price_data that normalizes MultiIndex to (ticker, field) before storing.

risks.description: Stochastic %D produces NaN for first stoch_k + stoch_d - 1 days; MACD warm-up period adds more NaN rows. Score percentile window requires min_lookback days.
risks.mitigation: ValueError raised if fewer than min_lookback days available after slicing to as_of_date. NaN rows dropped before percentile computation.

risks.description: RebalancePlan.leaps_trim for DRIFT rule cannot replicate leaps_scale update without executing it.
risks.mitigation: leaps_trim reports dollar amount only; scale update not simulated. Documented limitation in §7.

risks.description: compute_volatility_report called with return_data not covering portfolio.as_of_date.
risks.mitigation: build_volatility_model already raises ValueError for out-of-range dates; propagates naturally. Tested in F-012.

risks.description: MACD macd_bearish_confirmed uses groupby/cumsum pattern which has O(n²) worst case on long series.
risks.mitigation: Acceptable for 5-year daily series (~1250 rows). Document as known performance characteristic.
